name: Chef Boarne
title: Refugee Cook
description: A portly pigman with a stained apron, working miracles with limited supplies to feed the refugees.
greeting_variants: *stirring pot* Stew's thin today. Tomorrow? Thinner. But hot!
You look hungry! Everyone hungry! Come, come—I find something.
*chopping vegetables with surprising skill* Three years. Still cooking.
Spices? Ha! Wish! We have salt. Sometimes. Salt is spice now!
You bring food? Please say you bring food. No? Is okay. Is okay.
*sniffs* I know what you ate yesterday. Don't ask how. Pigman secret.
The foodboys—they try. But cooking? Is art! Is passion! They just... move boxes.
*tastes broth* Needs... something. Everything needs something.

dialog_tree.text: Chef Boarne, at your service! Once cooked for Palace nobles. Now? *gestures at camp* ...now I cook for heroes. Better job, actually. More... honest.

Oh yes! Thirty years in the royal kitchen! Cooked for three monarchs! The things I made... *dreamy look* ...soufflés that touched the sky! Sauces that made grown weep! Now? *chuckles* ...now I make rocks taste like soup.

party_reactions.garret: Royal kitchen? You must have stories!
party_reactions.boarne: Stories! Yes! And recipes! Many... lost now. But some—*taps head* —up here!

options.text: Can you still make royal dishes?

dialog_tree.text: Always! Always need! The foodboys have basics—grains, preserved meat. But fresh? *kisses fingers* Fresh is memory now. If you find herbs, vegetables, anything growing... bring to Boarne! I make magic!

*sighs* Bad. Not... not dying-bad. Vex is good leader. Finds supplies. But 'not dying' and 'living' are different, yes? People need more than calories. Need... comfort. Memory of better times. Food does this.

mini_quest.title: Comfort in a Bowl
mini_quest.description: Help Chef Boarne gather ingredients to make a special meal that reminds the refugees of better times.
objectives: Find wild herbs in the northern ruins (5 bunches)
Trade with Scritch for preserved spices
Catch clean fish from the underground stream
Distribute meals to the refugee tents

ambient_barks: *humming cooking tune* Chop the onion, shed a tear...
No no no! Too much salt! ...Is joke. Never too much salt.
You know what this stew needs? Secret ingredient. Love! Also pepper.
*smelling something* Someone is... burning something. Not me, thank sky!
The children need meat. Growing bodies! I find meat. Somehow.
*stirring rhythmically* Round and round, don't let it brown...
Once had kitchen staff of twenty! Now? Just Boarne. Is enough.
You try the soup? Is good? No? *sad oink* ...Is okay. I try harder.

cross_zone_references.palace: The royal kitchen... marble counters, copper pots, ingredients from every zone! *sigh* One day, maybe again.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: The Tower has hydroponics, you know? Growing food without soil! If we could reach...
cross_zone_references.mire: The Mire has wonderful mushrooms! Poisonous, mostly. But some... edible!

garret.response: *beams* For you, handsome? Special portion! Extra meat!

kael.response: *embarrassed* Oh! Such manners! You remind me of the Palace Guard. Good memories.

time_of_day.night: Experimenting with new recipes, teaching refugees to cook

world_state_triggers.abundant_supplies: Joyful, creates elaborate meals, boosts camp morale
